mapper.select: select (select count(1) from weight_user) as totalUsers, (select count(1) from weight_circle where ifnull(del_flag, '0') != '2') as totalCircles, ( select count(distinct user_id) from weight_habit_checkin where checked_at >= curdate() and checked_at < date_add(curdate(), interval 1 day) ) as todayCheckins, ( (select count(1) from weight_record) + (select count(1) from weight_food_record) + (select count(1) from weight_exercise_record) + (select count(1) from weight_water_record) + (select count(1) from weight_habit_checkin) ) as totalRecords, (select count(1) from weight_record) as weightRecords, (select count(1) from weight_food_record) as foodRecords, (select count(1) from weight_exercise_record) as exerciseRecords, (select count(1) from weight_water_record) as waterRecords, (select count(1) from weight_habit_checkin) as habitCheckins, ( select count(1) from weight_circle_feed where create_time >= curdate() and create_time < date_add(curdate(), interval 1 day) and ifnull(del_flag, '0') != '2' ) as todayFeeds, ( select count(1) from weight_feedback where status in ('pending', 'processing') ) as pendingFeedback, ( (select count(1) from weight_circle_feed where status = '1' and ifnull(del_flag, '0') != '2') + (select count(1) from weight_comment where status = '1' and ifnull(del_flag, '0') != '2') ) as pendingContent, ( (select count(1) from weight_circle_feed where status = '2' and ifnull(del_flag, '0') != '2') + (select count(1) from weight_comment where status = '2' and ifnull(del_flag, '0') != '2') ) as blockedContent, (select count(1) from weight_notification where ifnull(is_read, 0) = 0) as unreadNotifications

select ( select count(1) from weight_circle_feed where create_time >= curdate() and create_time < date_add(curdate(), interval 1 day) and ifnull(del_flag, '0') != '2' ) as todayFeeds, ( select count(1) from weight_comment where create_time >= curdate() and create_time < date_add(curdate(), interval 1 day) and ifnull(del_flag, '0') != '2' ) as todayComments, ( select count(1) from weight_circle_feed where visibility_scope = 'public' and ifnull(del_flag, '0') != '2' ) as publicFeeds, ( select count(1) from weight_circle_feed where ifnull(visibility_scope, 'circle') = 'circle' and ifnull(del_flag, '0') != '2' ) as circleFeeds, ( select count(1) from weight_circle_feed where status = '1' and ifnull(del_flag, '0') != '2' ) as pendingFeeds, ( select count(1) from weight_circle_feed where status = '2' and ifnull(del_flag, '0') != '2' ) as blockedFeeds, ( select count(1) from weight_comment where status = '1' and ifnull(del_flag, '0') != '2' ) as pendingComments, ( select count(1) from weight_comment where status = '2' and ifnull(del_flag, '0') != '2' ) as blockedComments, (select count(1) from weight_feedback where status = 'pending') as pendingFeedback, (select count(1) from weight_feedback where status = 'processing') as processingFeedback, (select count(1) from weight_feedback where status = 'resolved') as resolvedFeedback, (select count(1) from weight_feedback where status = 'closed') as closedFeedback, (select count(1) from weight_notification where ifnull(is_read, 0) = 0) as unreadNotifications

select date_format(checked_at, '%Y-%m-%d') as statDate, count(distinct user_id) as count from weight_habit_checkin where checked_at >= #{startTime} and checked_at < #{endTime} group by date_format(checked_at, '%Y-%m-%d') order by statDate asc

select c.id as id, c.name as name, coalesce(nullif(c.icon, ''), '⚖️') as icon, greatest(ifnull(max(c.member_count), 0), count(m.id)) as memberCount from weight_circle c left join weight_circle_member m on m.circle_id = c.id and m.status = '0' where ifnull(c.del_flag, '0') != '2' and ifnull(c.status, '0') = '0' group by c.id, c.name, c.icon order by memberCount desc, c.id asc limit #{limit}
